text:
olivia: Quick shoutout to Diego and Facilities for the impromptu AV rescue during the product demo. projector refused to cooperate and Diego ran in with a miracle HDMI dongle :raised_hands: :tada:

diego: lol I was half-asleep until the bugle call. happy it worked. shoutout to Facilities for the ladder and for lending the 'please don't break it' attitude :sweat_smile:

sana: big props. also whoever replenished the tea selection this morning
 deserves a medal :tea: (reactions: :heart: x3)

leo: placing a formal kudos here — Diego + Facilities = demo saved. also shout to whoever left the lemon cookies in the pantry  cookie hero.

facilities: thanks for the kind words! small favor: we have a maintenance window tomorrow morning at 8am, heads-up if folks need access to the big conference room.

olivia: noted, will update the calendar invite. also can we do a little thank-you treat? snackbot: make poll?

snackbot: Poll created: "Thank-you treat for Facilities"  React: 1 Donut box, 2 Sandwich tray, 3 Fruit + yogurt cups. Poll open 8h.

diego: 1 for me. warm sugar is powerful morale medicine.

sana: 3 to keep it light.

olivia: I'll pick up whichever wins and drop a kudos card at the front desk. thanks team for jumping in this morning 60a
